E20_prediction.a_ce_cost: fresh held CE minus the E19a parent (4.9742): <= +0.15 PROMISING; > +0.30 REFUTES this granularity (n=256, k=2)
E20_prediction.b_dead_codes: dead-code fraction (codes never used on the full fresh held pass, codebooks 0-22; codebook 23 causally inert and excluded) < 30% after training
E20_prediction.c_slack_vs_saturated: modules flagged slack in the E14 census (qk_e14.json census_e9a: mlp1, attn2, attn10) will use fewer distinct codes / lower usage entropy than saturated modules; tested as mean joint-usage-entropy(slack) < mean(saturated) AND Spearman(census write_cov_effective_rank, per-slot joint usage entropy) > 0 over slots 0-22

E20_config.quantized: every module-written slot's post-per-slot-RMSNorm content at every block-level read (hn and xn); slot content includes the bottom-injected embedding component (not separately routed in E15c); one quantization per slot per forward (content constant across consumers)
E20_config.not_quantized: not-yet-written slots (pure embedding content); the readout (continuous stream through the global RMSNorm) -- hence slot 23 (mlp11 write, readout-only) never passes through a codebook
E20_config.commitment: injected via qk_e_common.train_muon pop_aux_loss hook; NOT in final_penalty
E20_config.factory: E20Route subclass of qk_e15_reinvest_run.E15cRoute (make_e15c(s=15) config verbatim: true-small decoders, 24 x 15-dim slots, stream 360, compute 264, hidden 1056)

E20a.design: E19a architecture + per-slot codebook quantization (n=256, k=2 matching pursuit, straight-through, EMA + commitment beta 0.25 + dead-code reinit)
